description: This file defines the CommentSelection class for Drupal, providing custom entity reference selection and access control logic for comment entities.

classes.name: CommentSelection
classes.description: A class extending DefaultSelection to provide custom access control and query modifications for comment entity references in Drupal.

methods.name: buildEntityQuery
methods.description: Builds an entity query for comments, adding status conditions based on user permissions.

methods.name: createNewEntity
methods.description: Creates a new comment entity and sets it as published.

methods.name: validateReferenceableNewEntities
methods.description: Validates that new comment entities are published if the user lacks permission to administer comments.

methods.name: validateReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Validates that the referenced entities are accessible and published, considering user permissions.

methods.name: entityQueryAlter
methods.description: Alters the entity query to join comment data and handle comment-to-entity relationships, including access checks.

methods.name: getReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities that can be referenced, applying access checks and filtering.

methods.name: countReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Counts the number of referenceable entities matching criteria.
